## About
Air Zone Experts is a family-owned heating and cooling company run by Adrian and Cristina Racovei from their home base in Little Elm. We work on homes and businesses across Denton, Collin, and Dallas counties, including Frisco, The Colony, Prosper, and McKinney.
Adrian is a NATE-certified technician and is often on the job himself. We give you the price before any work starts, tell you plainly when a repair no longer makes sense, and work on all makes and models.
Our neighbors have given us a 5 rating across 425 Google reviews.

## Services
- AC repair: Diagnosis and repair of cooling problems, from refrigerant leaks and frozen coils to electrical parts and clogged drains.
- AC replacement: High-efficiency systems that help lower energy costs when a repair no longer makes sense.
- Air conditioning installation: Energy-efficient systems with careful setup for reliable cooling.
- Furnace and heating repair: Repairs for when the house will not stay warm.
- Heating system installation: New heating systems installed with care for lasting comfort.
- Air duct repair and replacement: Duct work that helps your system run efficiently and improves indoor air quality.
- One year maintenance agreement: Coupon price for homeowners, one coupon per service address. ($120.00 / System)

## FAQ
Q: Does the owner come out on service calls?
A: Often, yes. Adrian Racovei personally handles many of our service calls, diagnostics, and installations.

Q: Do you work on homes and businesses?
A: Yes. We serve homeowners and business owners throughout Denton, Collin, and Dallas counties.

Q: What brands do you service?
A: All major HVAC brands, including Trane, Carrier, Lennox, and Rheem.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes, we offer flexible financing options for customers who qualify.
